integration: Model arithmetic, inputs and native greedy generation are unchanged. The worker observes already-selected CPU streamer IDs, preserves incomplete checkpoints, and verifies them against the returned sequence. GB10 admission uses 72 GiB host MemAvailable. Preparation and scoring reuse repository helpers.

cache_profile.initialization: Create the explicit Torch cache directory before starting Python. Triton creates its own cache directory.
cache_profile.preflight: Before a service pause, require a successful 4 GiB, 60-second no-model kernel preflight and cleanup using the same cache environment and tmpfs options as the model container.

extended_reference.partial_tokens: Atomically checkpoint every 128 selected CPU tokens and at EOS/end. Checkpoints remain marked incomplete. Require exact equality with returned generation IDs before final result evidence.
extended_reference.timing_limit: Three hours permits an average 4.60 tokens/s after 120 seconds of setup, below the final observed 6.92 tokens/s interval. Decode slowdown and observer I/O may still exhaust the bound.
